zh.what: 连接 Hugging Face（开源模型分享平台）的客户端，用代码下载、上传模型和数据集等文件。
zh.before: 在网页上手动下载模型文件，或用 git 克隆大文件仓库，自己管理缓存。

roles.dev: 用 hf_hub_download 下载一个小模型的配置文件。
roles.pm: 让产品方便地获取和切换开源模型，也能托管自有模型。
roles.qa: 关注网络超时、令牌权限、缓存占满磁盘和镜像源配置。

en.what: The client for Hugging Face, a platform for sharing open models: download and upload models, datasets and other repo files from code.
en.before: Downloading model files manually from the website or cloning large-file Git repos and managing caches yourself.

roles.dev: Download a small model's config file with hf_hub_download.
roles.pm: Makes fetching and switching open-source models easy, and hosting your own models feasible.
roles.qa: Watch network timeouts, token permissions, full disk caches and mirror settings.
roles.algo: The fetch step before training or inference, getting models and data, and for publishing results.

zh.what: 统一加载和使用预训练模型（别人已训练好的模型）的框架，覆盖文本、图像、语音，可推理也可训练。
zh.before: 每个模型各有一套代码和权重格式，复现论文要逐个适配。

roles.dev: 用 pipeline 加载一个情感分析模型，输入一句话看结果。
roles.pm: 让本地部署、微调开源模型变得可行，不必依赖外部 API。
roles.qa: 关注模型与库版本不兼容、显存不足、分词不一致导致的输出偏差。
roles.algo: 模型定义层，向下调用 PyTorch，向上支撑微调和推理框架。

en.what: A framework giving one interface to load, run and train pretrained models (models already trained by others) for text, vision, audio and multimodal tasks.
en.before: Each model came with its own code and weight format, so reproducing papers meant adapting each one separately.

roles.dev: Load a sentiment-analysis model with pipeline and classify a sentence.
roles.pm: Makes running and fine-tuning open models feasible in-house, without depending on external APIs.
roles.qa: Watch model and library version incompatibilities, GPU memory limits and output drift from tokenizer mismatches.
roles.algo: The model-definition layer: built on PyTorch, underpinning fine-tuning and inference frameworks.

zh.what: 安全保存模型权重的文件格式：加载时不会执行隐藏代码，比 pickle 格式安全，读取也快。
zh.before: 用 PyTorch 默认的 pickle 格式，加载来路不明的模型文件可能执行恶意代码。

roles.dev: 用 save_file 保存一个张量字典，再用 load_file 读回。
roles.pm: 让产品安全加载第三方开源模型，降低供应链风险。
roles.qa: 关注文件损坏、权重名称不匹配和格式转换后结果是否一致。
roles.algo: 模型权重的存储格式，连接训练产出与推理加载。

en.what: A file format for storing model weights safely: loading never runs hidden code, unlike pickle-based files, and it loads quickly.
en.before: PyTorch's default pickle-based .bin/.pt files, which could execute malicious code when loading untrusted models.

roles.dev: Save a dict of tensors with save_file and read it back with load_file.
roles.pm: Lets products load third-party open models safely, reducing supply-chain risk.
roles.qa: Check corrupted files, mismatched weight names and identical outputs after format conversion.
roles.algo: The weight storage format linking training output to inference loading.

zh.what: Hugging Face 用 Rust 编写的快速分词器库，把文本切成 token 并转成编号，也能训练新词表。
zh.before: 用纯 Python 实现分词，处理大语料时很慢，各模型实现也不统一。

roles.dev: 用 from_pretrained 加载一个分词器，编码一句话。
roles.pm: 用户不可见；让本地模型处理文本更快，支持自定义词表。
roles.qa: 关注分词器与模型不匹配、特殊符号和超长文本截断。
roles.algo: 训练和推理的输入端：把文本转换成 token 编号。

en.what: Hugging Face's fast tokenizer library written in Rust: splits text into tokens, maps them to IDs, and can train new vocabularies.
en.before: Pure-Python tokenizers that were slow on large corpora, with inconsistent implementations across models.

roles.dev: Load bert-base-uncased with Tokenizer.from_pretrained and encode a sentence.
roles.pm: Invisible to users; speeds up text handling for local models and enables custom vocabularies.
roles.qa: Watch tokenizers mismatched to models, special tokens and truncation of long texts.
roles.algo: The input end of training and inference: converting text into token IDs.

zh.what: Hugging Face 的训练辅助库：同一份 PyTorch 代码稍作修改，就能在单卡、多卡、多机或混合精度下运行。
zh.before: 为单卡和多卡分布式分别写代码，手动处理设备分配和进程启动。

roles.dev: 先运行 accelerate config，再用 launch 命令启动脚本。
roles.pm: 让团队用现有显卡训练或微调更大的模型，降低工程成本。
roles.qa: 关注多卡结果不一致、显存溢出和配置与机器不符。
roles.algo: 位于训练代码与硬件之间，负责分布式和设备调度。

en.what: A Hugging Face library that lets the same PyTorch code run on one GPU, many GPUs, multiple machines or mixed precision with minimal changes.
en.before: Writing separate code for single-GPU and distributed setups, managing device placement and process launching by hand.

roles.dev: Run accelerate config to create a setup, then start your script with accelerate launch.
roles.pm: Lets teams train or fine-tune larger models on existing GPUs with less engineering effort.
roles.qa: Watch inconsistent multi-GPU results, out-of-memory errors and configs that don't match the machine.
roles.algo: Sits between training code and hardware, handling distribution and device placement.

roles.qa: Check offline logging when the network drops, API key setup, and sensitive data being uploaded.
roles.algo: Sits in training: records hyperparameters, metric curves and model files.

en.what: Hugging Face's parameter-efficient fine-tuning library, such as LoRA: train a small set of added parameters to adapt an LLM to new tasks.

roles.dev: Wrap a model with LoraConfig and get_peft_model, then print its trainable parameter share.
roles.pm: Makes customizing LLMs with your own data cheaper; each use case keeps only a small adapter.
roles.qa: Check adapter-to-base-model mismatches and quality changes after merging weights.
roles.algo: Sits in fine-tuning, training small adapters on top of pretrained models.
